## Company
SoftBiz is a full-service digital agency headquartered in Dallas, Texas. We specialize in web development (Next.js/React), Shopify e-commerce, Amazon seller management, and digital marketing services for startups and growing brands.

## Services
- Web Development: Custom Next.js and React websites, PWAs, and web applications
- Shopify Solutions: Custom theme development, Shopify Plus, headless commerce (Hydrogen)
- Amazon Services: FBA management, PPC campaigns, listing optimization, A+ content
- Digital Marketing: Technical SEO, content strategy, backlink outreach
- Google Ads: Search, Display, and Shopping PPC campaign management
- Social Media: Paid social advertising on Meta, TikTok, and Instagram
